title: Mark (articulating profile)
description: The articulation locus's profile of the canonical mark: the arbitrary atomic primitive, the genus of which token and claim are the two kinds. A mark's value is a literal surface string, or a `ni:` content address (the immutable replacement for the retired URI-era pointers) standing for a larger document.

value.description: A literal surface string, or a `ni:` content address (`^ni:///sha-256;...`) standing for a larger document. Surface form, not identity.
